body_markdown:
*D.C.-based bank goes live with MANTL to expand customer acquisition, strengthen relationship banking, and support long-term growth*


**PLANO, Texas — Oct.** **** **** **14** **, 2026** — Alkami Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALKT) (“Alkami”), a[digital sales and service platform provider](https://www.alkami.com/?utm_source=public-relations&utm_medium=press-release&utm_campaign=2026-PRInfluencer-PressRelease-CityFirst) for financial institutions in the U.S., today announced that[City First Bank](https://cityfirstbank.com/) has selected[MANTL Onboarding & Account Opening](https://www.alkami.com/mantl-onboarding-account-opening/?utm_source=public-relations&utm_medium=press-release&utm_campaign=2026-PRInfluencer-PressRelease-CityFirst) to modernize its retail account opening across its physical and digital banking channels.


City First Bank will leverage the full omnichannel suite of[MANTL](https://www.alkami.com/mantl-onboarding-account-opening/?utm_source=public-relations&utm_medium=press-release&utm_campaign=2026-PRInfluencer-PressRelease-CityFirst) solutions to create a more seamless account opening experience, equip relationship managers with more efficient workflows, and establish a scalable foundation for expanding beyond its traditional footprint. By implementing[MANTL Retail Account Opening](https://www.alkami.com/mantl-onboarding-account-opening/mantl-retail-account-opening/?utm_source=public-relations&utm_medium=press-release&utm_campaign=2026-PRInfluencer-PressRelease-CityFirst) , the bank is investing in technology that supports sustainable growth while continuing to deliver the level of service its customers expect.


“At City First Bank, making banking accessible starts at the front door. Today that door is digital. Partnership with MANTL means our community can open an account in minutes from anywhere, without encountering obstacles,” said Brian Argrett, president and chief executive officer at City First Bank. “It is a simple change that makes a huge difference in helping people save, grow, and build their financial future.”


City First continues to lead with its mission at the forefront. As a Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI), Minority Depository Institution (MDI), Certified B Corporation, Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and member of the National Bankers Association, City First Bank is reinforcing its commitment to investing in innovative technology like MANTL that expands financial access for the communities it serves throughout Washington, D.C., Los Angeles, and beyond.


As the bank continues expanding its reach, MANTL will help City First Bank reach more customers nationwide by delivering a modern account opening experience that preserves the personalized service that differentiates the institution.


“Today’s financial institutions need technology that helps them grow relationships, expand into new markets, and create omnichannel experiences that differentiate their institution,” said Benjamin Conant, chief product officer at Alkami. “City First Bank has a clear vision for growth while remaining deeply committed to its mission and the communities it serves. We’re excited to partner with their team as they execute that vision with an omnichannel account opening experience that supports[deposit growth](https://www.alkami.com/deposit-growth/) , strengthens relationship banking, and positions the bank for long-term success.”


With MANTL, City First Bank will be able to automate more than 85% of application decisions, including Know Your Customer (KYC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) checks, as well as product setup, funding, and core booking, reducing manual intervention and increasing operational efficiency.


To learn how MANTL can transform your account opening process and empower your team, or to schedule a demo, click[here](https://www.mantl.com/request-a-demo/) .


To learn more about Anticipatory Banking and the Alkami Digital Sales & Service Platform, visit[here](https://www.alkami.com/digital-banking-solutions?utm_source=public-relations&utm_medium=press-release&utm_campaign=2026-PRInfluencer-PressRelease-CityFirst&utm_term=here&utm_content=alkami-digital-banking-platform) .


**About Alkami**


[Alkami](https://www.alkami.com/press-room?utm_source=public-relations&utm_medium=press-release&utm_campaign=2026-PRInfluencer-PressRelease-CityFirst&utm_term=alkami-technology&utm_content=press-room) provides a digital sales and service platform for U.S.[banks](https://www.alkami.com/banks/) and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.


**About City First Bank**


City First Bank offers a variety of commercial real estate loan products, services, and depository accounts that support investments in affordable housing, small businesses, and nonprofit community facilities located within underinvested neighborhoods. City First Bank is a Community Development Financial Institution, Certified B Corp, and a member of the Global Alliance of Banking on Values. The Bank and the City First network of nonprofits, City First Enterprises, Homes By CFE, and City First Foundation, represent the City First branded family of community development financial institutions, which offer a robust lending and deposit platform.
